aiHeadlines: 📊 Eintracht Frankfurt top the Bundesliga on 7 points after 3 rounds.
⏰ Deadline day is done. The window is shut until January.
⏳ Deadline week. Any business left undone stays undone until the next window.
Liverpool sign Aleksandar Pavlovic from Bayern Munich for £82m.
RB Leipzig sign Ayyoub Bouaddi from Manchester City for £53m.
Juventus sign Gabriel from Arsenal for £74m.
Bayern Munich sign Yan Diomande from Real Madrid for £80m.
Bayern Munich sign Julián Alvarez from Atlético Madrid for £73m.

inbox.text: One of your forwards has been parking in your spot all month and putting a traffic cone on his own.

options.label: Take the cone spot, be the bigger man

inbox.text: A reporter from the local paper is running a piece on whether this squad is good enough for what the board have asked of you. He wants a line from you before it goes out.

An agent has been in touch about Finn Jeltsch, who is 19 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £7.2m up front on 40k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.

pending.text: Bayern Munich on paper are a level above you. Realistically, what are you going there for?

options.label: Nobody gives us a prayer, and that suits us
options.line: Underdogs and happy about it. Exactly the week your squad needed.

options.label: We are going to win it
options.line: A big call in front of a big audience. They have seen it too.

options.label: We will do our jobs and see
options.line: Dull, safe and forgotten by Friday teatime. The board like a man who promises nothing.

decisions.text: The squad's fines kitty has £100k in it from late arrivals and phones in meetings. The head coach asks where it should go. The local paper always runs it when it goes to charity.

options.label: Give it to the club's community partner (press mood +2)
Put it in the transfer pot (£100k into the transfer budget)
Leave it in the kitty (nothing changes)
